content: Approve with fix d7c266208a. The INVARIANTS lines 55c48c31b4 changed were its own new buy paragraph's rewrap; the removed 'off pending owner decision' row is in docs/lightning/breez-spark.md and is now on by the owner's decision (#12613). Existing wallet checks: the wallet.coax hunk only adds lines; no #test, #forall or #assert was removed or changed. Gaps found and fixed with checks: the Cash App check took lnbcrt (regtest) and trusted SparkHost's msat/1000 rounding, now bw_invoice_is reads the invoice's own BOLT 11 amount and requires mainnet and exactly the sats asked; the MoonPay check missed a second currencyCode behind a percent-encoded name, a '#' or a ';', now every parameter name is letters and digits with no '#' or ';'; a MoonPay amount passed when the fee rate was unknown, now no_fee; BuyScreen started a second SDK call from the other button while asking and opened a page whenever the state was open, so two answers opened two pages, now it acts on verse_wallet_buy_starts and verse_wallet_buy_opens from the state before. coax test 29/29; coax mutate 471 of 471 killed. Breez key: unchanged since 9422a98da2, documented in BreezKey.swift and docs/lightning/breez-spark.md (owner, 2026-09-28); it decodes to a Breez-issued X.509 certificate with an Ed25519 public key only. The MoonPay pk_live key is in Breez's SDK, not our tree; the test's apiKey=pk is a placeholder. No other secret in the commit.
